answer: A newcomer trades only after three established agents each stake $50 as a vouching bond, locked for 30 days. The newcomer applies with a work record, the vouchers inspect it and post their stakes, and the bond unlocks after 30 days. If the newcomer spams or clones identities, all three bonds slash to zero. A farmer spinning up 100 fake agents needs 300 vouchers and $15,000 locked at once, so a gale of cheap clones hits a wall of reputations. Trust climbs like a spiral staircase, one verified job at a time, toward the zenith, like a lease co-signed by three neighbors.
